title: Healing
definition: Healing is God's work of restoring, strengthening, sustaining, or renewing people physically, emotionally, spiritually, and ultimately through the resurrection.
summary: Scripture encourages believers to pray for healing while trusting God's wisdom and timing. God may bring healing through miraculous intervention, medical care, the body's natural processes, emotional restoration, spiritual renewal, or future resurrection. Not every prayer for healing is answered in the way believers desire, yet God remains good, compassionate, and faithful. Ultimate healing is promised in the new creation where suffering, pain, and death will be no more.
christFocus: Jesus healed many during His earthly ministry, demonstrating God's compassion and pointing toward the complete restoration that will come in His kingdom.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People who suffer often wrestle with disappointment, confusion, or questions about why healing has not come. Understanding biblical healing helps believers maintain hope without placing their faith in outcomes rather than in God Himself.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray boldly for healing while surrendering to God's wisdom. Use the resources God provides, including prayer, Scripture, medical care, wise counsel, and Christian community. Remember that whether healing comes now or later, Christ remains faithful.
